text: Correction: the Antigravity orchestrator had already added the same fix as **R7** `r7-kit-py-launch-updates-runner-on-takeover` (train runners, after R5), so I dropped my CL63 duplicate. Separately, from your chat question: **CL64** `cl64-resume-sees-whether-a-web-part-is-alive`: resume reads `claude agents` (this machine only), so in a cloud container every web part shows 'not running/stalled'; CL55 and CL45 sync work and posts, never liveness. CL64 makes resume use the recorded list_sessions state and the part's own heartbeat.
